in_marathi.name: Gangaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे River God Ganga's Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gangaram is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ganga’, which refers to the sacred river Ganges, and ‘Ram’, which means the protector. Thus, the name Gangaram signifies one who protects the river Ganga.
